text_block_list.text:
I saw it! A vast expanse stretching ahead
of me
with no one else in sight... It's
almost a shame I
had to cross the finish
line...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Maybe I'll see it again next race.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
That's right. I got first place. I was so
focused...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Yes... I wish I could have run a bit longer.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer. I'm looking forward to the
next race.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
I was able to concentrate completely on
running...
It was a good race.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
I want to see that scenery again and
again.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука
